paragraphs.source_en: The maple leaves that had stitched two or three bands of red among the red pines had fallen like dreams of long ago; and the red and white sasanqua blossoms that had scattered their petals by turns near the washbasin before the privy had now all dropped away. On the south-facing veranda, three and a half ken long, the winter sunlight was already slanting quickly away. Days without a biting north wind had become almost rare. Around this time, I felt as though the hours allowed for my afternoon nap had grown shorter.

units.source_zh: 点缀在赤松林间的两三层红叶，犹如逝去的梦一般凋落了；

units.source_en: and the red and white sasanqua blossoms that had scattered their petals by turns near the washbasin before the privy had now all dropped away.
units.source_zh: 茅厕前面的洗手钵附近，交互散落着花瓣的红白山茶花，现在也零落罄尽。

units.source_en: On the south-facing veranda, three and a half ken long, the winter sunlight was already slanting quickly away.
units.source_zh: 那朝南的三“间”半长的前廊上，冬天的日光已很快倾斜。

units.source_en: Days without a biting north wind had become almost rare.
units.source_zh: 不刮凛冽北风的日子几乎已很少。

units.source_en: Around this time, I felt as though the hours allowed for my afternoon nap had grown shorter.
units.source_zh: 这一时期，我觉得午睡时间似乎缩短了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 点缀在赤松林间的两三层红叶，犹如逝去的梦一般凋落了；茅厕前面的洗手钵附近，交互散落着花瓣的红白山茶花，现在也零落罄尽。那朝南的三“间”半长的前廊上，冬天的日光已很快倾斜。不刮凛冽北风的日子几乎已很少。这一时期，我觉得午睡时间似乎缩短了。

paragraphs.source_en: My master goes to school every day, and as soon as he returns he shuts himself up in his study. When visitors come, he is forever saying, “I am sick of teaching, sick of teaching.” He hardly ever paints watercolors now. Having decided that his stomach medicine does him no good, he has stopped taking that too. The children, however, are admirable: every day they go to kindergarten without fail. After school they sing songs, bounce a ball, and now and then seize me by the tail and dangle me upside down.

units.source_en: My master goes to school every day, and as soon as he returns he shuts himself up in his study.
units.source_zh: 主人每天到学校去，一回来就躲在书斋里。

units.source_en: When visitors come, he is forever saying, “I am sick of teaching, sick of teaching.”
units.source_zh: 客人来了，他总是说：“干够教师啦，干够教师啦。”

units.source_en: He hardly ever paints watercolors now.
Having decided that his stomach medicine does him no good, he has stopped taking that too.

ja.t: がないといって、やめてしまった。

units.source_zh: 他认为胃散治不了病，也不再喝了。

units.source_en: The children, however, are admirable: every day they go to kindergarten without fail.
units.source_zh: 而小孩子倒是令人敬佩，每天都去幼儿园，从不间断。

units.source_en: After school they sing songs, bounce a ball, and now and then seize me by the tail and dangle me upside down.
units.source_zh: 放学后，唱唱歌，拍拍球，还时常揪住我的尾巴，把我倒提起来。

paragraphs.source_zh: 主人每天到学校去，一回来就躲在书斋里。客人来了，他总是说：“干够教师啦，干够教师啦。”水彩画也轻易不画了。他认为胃散治不了病，也不再喝了。而小孩子倒是令人敬佩，每天都去幼儿园，从不间断。放学后，唱唱歌，拍拍球，还时常揪住我的尾巴，把我倒提起来。

paragraphs.source_en: Since I eat no delicacies, I have not grown especially fat. At least I remain more or less healthy, have not gone lame, and live on from day to day. As for mice, I never catch them. I still dislike O-san the maid, and still no one has given me a name. If one starts speaking of desires, there is no end to them. I have resolved to spend my whole life in this teacher’s house and end my days as a nameless cat.

units.source_en: Since I eat no delicacies, I have not grown especially fat.
units.source_zh: 我不吃美味佳肴，所以也没发胖。

units.source_en: At least I remain more or less healthy, have not gone lame, and live on from day to day.
units.source_zh: 至少身体还健康，没有成为瘸腿，就这样一天一天地活下去。

units.source_en: As for mice, I never catch them.
I still dislike O-san the maid, and still no one has given me a name.

ja.t: はまだつけてくれない。

units.source_zh: 我仍然讨厌厨娘阿三，仍然没有人给我起名字。

units.source_en: If one starts speaking of desires, there is no end to them.
units.source_zh: 要说欲望，那是无穷无尽的。

units.source_en: I have resolved to spend my whole life in this teacher’s house and end my days as a nameless cat.
units.source_zh: 我已下决心一辈子呆在这个教师家里，作个无名的猫儿，了结此生吧。

paragraphs.source_zh: 我不吃美味佳肴，所以也没发胖。至少身体还健康，没有成为瘸腿，就这样一天一天地活下去。老鼠我是决不捕捉的。我仍然讨厌厨娘阿三，仍然没有人给我起名字。要说欲望，那是无穷无尽的。我已下决心一辈子呆在这个教师家里，作个无名的猫儿，了结此生吧。
